description: Preserve deployment_id in the PUT /accounts/{account_id}/workers/scripts/{script_name} response. The mirrored response omits the upload's immutable Worker version identifier, so decoding currently drops it. Cloudflare's official deployment client declares deployment_id as string | null and normalizes it into versionId after uploading: https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/blob/56974d49141e72b19b33b74a19c160f734128108/packages/deploy-helpers/src/deploy/deploy.ts#L535-L542 and #L680. This is an uploaded version ID, not a /deployments record ID. Keep it optional for responses without a receipt; the Cloudflare generator makes optional response members nullable.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Immutable Worker version created by this upload, not a deployment record ID.
